best_idea: A capture point is claimed only when enough group members are physically inside its area, is refused during combat, then ramps one level per timer; a lord kill flips the owner's realm to the killer's group leader's realm and resets the level.
decision_why: The claim gate and the owner reset fit capturable zone points as zone data with server-verified claims; the donor's ramp is off by default and its restart arithmetic is odd, and Frankendom has no guild model, so port the shape only.
acceptance: Server test: a claim with fewer group members inside the point radius than groupMinimum is refused with a reason; a complete claim sets owner and level to startLevelOwned; a lord kill by group G sets realm to G's leader's realm and level to startLevelUnowned.
